scope: perceptual visual parity; native geometry and World data frozen

focal hierarchy.before: The map has scale but little frame depth; the small lamp does not organize nearby values.
focal hierarchy.target: A richer desk plane, layered map frame and local task light form one dominant focal group.

lighting.before: Fixtures are readable icons, but nearby surfaces remain almost uniformly lit.
lighting.target: Cool light affects upper walls, steel and nearby floor; warm light stays local to the sheriff desktop and edge.

material differentiation.before: Large flat panels and a few trim lines give oak, steel and flooring similarly simple shading.
material differentiation.target: Directional oak edges, cool sharp metal, calm painted bands, quiet linoleum values, clean paper and sparse crisp glass reflections.

depth.before: Uniform rectangular cast shadows do not establish tight furniture contact.
depth.target: Compact dark cores, adjacent occlusion bands and leg contacts; stronger player grounding without touching sprite or depth ordering.

environmental density.before: The office loses most functional signs of occupation from the concept.
environmental density.target: A clearer county map, coat/hat, radio and subdued notices on existing surfaces; no new floor obstacles or surplus clutter.

same-game quality.before: The pixel scale is correct but surfaces still read as a simplified prototype.
same-game quality.target: Deliberate native clusters carry confident depth and hierarchy at 256x192 and integer scale, without borrowing concept gradients or fine noise.
